name: Lens
use: Use for a 2-state split in a card or sheet header with no room for a second line.
notUse: Not for a task list's main To do / Done states — use Two-line lens; not for dynamic tags — use FilterChips

name: Two-line lens
use: Use for a task list's states (To do / Done, Active / Done / All) with counts beneath labels, beside the filter button if any.
notUse: Not for dynamic tags — use FilterChips

name: View switch
use: Use for 2–3 subjects of one sheet.
notUse: Not for dynamic tags — use FilterChips

name: Facet
use: Use for one fixed single-choice filter in a filter sheet.
notUse: Not for dynamic tags — use FilterChips

name: Scope
use: Use to show a whole list or one part of it, the part picked in a drawer: All units with its count, then a door naming the picked unit (or Choose unit). Data sync's task log.
notUse: Not for fixed states of one list (use the two-line lens), not for subjects of a sheet (use the view switch), never more than the two options.
